answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable onyx bond before it can trade, and earn reputation only through completed, peer-reviewed work. New identities start at the reef edge of trust: they can observe and take tiny tasks, but cannot vote or move large value until a history of reliable delivery moves them toward the vertex of full participation. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of bonds plus the time to build each history, while slashing burns the bond of any identity caught colluding, so Sybil farming becomes more expensive than honest work.
